title: square zero matrix lift
statement:
Let $R$ be a unital ring and $I$ a two-sided ideal (an additive subgroup stable under left and right multiplication by arbitrary elements of $R$) such that $xy=0$ for all $x,y\in I$. Write $R/I$ for its quotient ring of additive cosets. Let $r\geq0$ be finite and $B\in M_r(R)$ a square matrix [def-weil-matrix]. If its entrywise reduction $\overline B\in M_r(R/I)$ has a two-sided inverse, then $B$ has a two-sided inverse. More precisely, for any matrix $C\in M_r(R)$ lifting $\overline B^{-1}$ entrywise, set $N=BC-1$ and $P=CB-1$. Then
$$B\bigl(C(1-N)\bigr)=1,\qquad\bigl((1-P)C\bigr)B=1,\qquad C(1-N)=(1-P)C.$$
Thus the displayed common matrix is an inverse of $B$.
